s: Love justice and seek God with a sincere heart. God did not make death.
The wicked plan to persecute the just man, who calls God his father.
The souls of the just are in the hand of God and are at peace.
An early death for the just is not a loss. The wicked will be judged.
The wicked see the just in glory and regret their lives.
Kings and rulers should seek wisdom.
Solomon prayed for wisdom and valued her above everything.
Solomon sought wisdom as a bride.
Wisdom guided the patriarchs, from Adam to Moses.
Wisdom led Israel through the desert, while Egypt was punished.
God is merciful even in punishing, giving time to repent.
The foolishness of worshipping nature and idols.
The folly of idols made by human hands.
God's people do not worship idols.
God punished Egypt with animals but fed Israel with bread from heaven.
The plague of darkness on Egypt.
Light for Israel, and the death of Egypt's firstborn.
The crossing of the Red Sea. God has glorified his people at all times.
